comment.body: Could you provide the exact steps used to launch PowerToys as administrator, including whether you are launching PowerToys itself or Mouse Without Borders settings, and what happens after selecting Run as administrator? Please also include the exact Preview version/build, Windows version/build, installation scope, whether PowerToys is already running, and any error message or screenshot. If possible, attach a PowerToys Report Bug ZIP so we can distinguish an elevation failure from a Store-package or Mouse Without Borders issue.
